[[File:Zedalus_Tree.png|thumb|right|200px|The Zedalus Tree in the Ancient Rakatan Keep]]
The '''Zedalus Tree''' was a massive [[aphor tree]] that grew in the region of [[the Tomb]] known as the [[Ancient Rakatan Keep]], with its trunk settled on a large rock outcropping and its roots linking it to smaller outcroppings in the area.
